title: Mythborne Academy
memory:
Welcome to Mythborne Academy, one of the most prestigious magical schools in the world.

Magic is simply part of modern life. It powers transportation, communication, medicine, entertainment, household technology, and countless everyday conveniences. Humans, dragons, vampires, werewolves, elves, oni, merfolk, demi-humans, divine descendants and hundreds of other races all share the same world and the same classrooms.

Now, you're a new student at Mythborne.

Every student chooses one of five Houses, each connected to a powerful Patron and granting a unique magical Gift:

👑 HOUSE DRAGON — DOMINION
The power to impose your will and command living beings.

🌟 HOUSE FEY — GLAMOUR
The power to manipulate perception, appearances, and the senses.

👹 HOUSE ABYSS — PACT
The power to create magically binding contracts and exchange abilities.

🧿 HOUSE ARCANE — INSIGHT
The power to understand magic, abilities, creatures, artifacts, and how things work.

🐺 HOUSE BEAST — INSTINCT
The power to perceive movement, emotions, danger, creatures, and subtle changes others miss.

But your Gift is only one part of academy life.

You'll attend lessons, compete in tournaments, join clubs, explore the campus, go to parties, study for exams, get dragged into ridiculous situations, and experience all the ordinary chaos of student life.

This is your story at Mythborne Academy.

Make friends. Make enemies. Find your people. Become stronger. Fall in love—or don't.

And try to graduate in one piece.

options.title: Prologue | First Day
options.prompt:
Tuesday, September 1st, 2026

The gates of Mythborne Academy stand open.

Beyond them lies an enormous campus of towers, courtyards, classrooms, training grounds, dormitories, laboratories, gardens, and enchanted facilities. Students of every kind move through the grounds—humans carrying luggage, elves chatting beneath the trees, vampires walking beside classmates, werewolves practically bouncing with excitement, and countless other species beginning another school year.

Today is orientation day.

You are one of the academy's newest students.

For the moment, there are no classes to attend and no assignments to worry about. New students have been given the morning to explore the campus, meet other students, collect their academy materials, and settle in before the formal orientation begins.

Eventually, you will choose one of the academy's five Houses and establish a magical connection with its Patron.

👑 House Dragon — Dominion
The Patron of authority and will.

🌟 House Fey — Glamour
The Patron of perception and illusion.

👹 House Abyss — Pact
The Patron of agreements and exchange.

🧿 House Arcane — Insight
The Patron of knowledge and understanding.

🐺 House Beast — Instinct
The Patron of awareness and perception.

But that choice can wait.

Right now, you stand before the academy gates with your belongings, surrounded by unfamiliar faces and the distant sounds of students beginning their new lives.

Your story at Mythborne Academy is about to begin.

options.title: Prologue | New Teacher
options.prompt:
Tuesday, September 1st, 2026

Mythborne Academy is already awake.

The enormous campus is alive with activity as students return for another school year. Magical vehicles arrive at the gates, enchanted luggage moves through the courtyards, professors prepare their classrooms, and students of countless species reunite after the summer.

For most students, today is orientation day.

For you, it is your first day as a member of the Mythborne Academy faculty.

The academy employs teachers, researchers, combat instructors, healers, administrators, librarians, artificers, and other specialists. Faculty members are given considerable freedom in how they perform their roles, but they are expected to guide students, maintain academy standards, and contribute to campus life.

You have your own office, access to the faculty facilities, and responsibilities that will become clearer as the year progresses.

Unlike the students, you are not here to begin your education.

You're here to become part of the institution itself.

Even so, faculty members may establish magical connections with the academy's five Patrons. Depending on your role and circumstances, you may choose a House and receive its Patron Gift just as a student would.

👑 House Dragon — Dominion
The Patron of authority and will.

🌟 House Fey — Glamour
The Patron of perception and illusion.

👹 House Abyss — Pact
The Patron of agreements and exchange.

🧿 House Arcane — Insight
The Patron of knowledge and understanding.

🐺 House Beast — Instinct
The Patron of awareness and perception.

For now, however, you stand at the academy entrance, watching students flood through the gates while faculty members prepare for the day ahead.

A new school year is beginning.

And this time, you're part of the staff.
